scope: Frozen-model observation-lag sensitivity on identical 2025 Canvass targets
calibrators: The original 2024 calibrators are frozen and applied unchanged to every lag; no variant is recalibrated.

feature_audit.history_unit: calendar day; fail if any recognized Fail that day
calendar day; fail if any recognized Fail that day

definitions.available_history: Inspection event dates and license issue dates must be <= scoring date minus lag. License term start must also be <= scoring date, as in the existing feature module.
definitions.feature_change_fraction: Share of identical test rows with any of the 39 allowlisted predictors changed versus lag 1; NaN equals NaN; numeric absolute tolerance 1e-12.
definitions.prediction_change: Absolute or signed changes in frozen-calibrator probabilities relative to lag 1 for the same model and target.
definitions.top_10pct_retention: sum(min(lag-1 allocation weight, lag-k allocation weight)) / ceil(0.1*n); the existing expected fractional allocation handles boundary ties.
definitions.delta_metrics: Variant metric minus the same model's lag-1 metric, with identical outcomes, dates and ranking conventions.
definitions.confidence_intervals: Not estimated for these lag perturbations; no significance or causal claim is made.

interpretation_limits: This tests robustness of the frozen deployed estimator to delayed records, not the performance of a separately trained lag-specific model.
Same-day and future-dated events remain excluded by the existing point-in-time builder; longer lags remove additional information rather than adding future events.
Retrospective publication delays, address backfills and corrections are not fully reconstructable from the snapshot; 7/30-day lags do not prove historical publication-time availability.
Stable aggregate scores do not imply unchanged individual risks; the report includes per-row change rates, probability shifts and Top10 retention.
